changelog:
Initial release — easily guide anyone in selecting the right water heater:

- Interviews users about household size, usage, fuel type, installation space, regional climate, and water quality.
- Offers unbiased water heater recommendations tailored to the user’s needs — no brand suggestions.
- Clarifies confusing specs and terms, helping users avoid under- or over-spending.
- Supports all major water heater types: storage, instant/tankless, electric, gas, and solar-compatible.
- Adapts questions and advice based on user’s technical knowledge and regional standards.
summary: Guide users buying a water heater through household size, fuel type, capacity, and recovery rate questions to find the exact geyser or boiler specs they need...
